result_text:
The contributor lists and the recent-commits bar chart no longer stop at `contributorsListLimit`. The `reports` module compiles, and its test suite passes (1 test). The project has no landscape-specific tests, so I did not generate an HTML report to check the output by eye.

Changes, both in `reports/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/reports/landscape/statichtml/`:

- **`LandscapeContributorsReport.java`** (`saveContributorsTable`): removed the `.limit(...)` on the contributor table and the "The list is limited to N items" note. This method also serves the bots and teams pages, so they are covered too. The sort order is unchanged.
- **`LandscapeReportContributorsTab.java`** (`addRecentContributorsSection`): removed the `.limit(...)` on the bar chart, so it draws one bar per recently active contributor.

`contributorsListLimit` is still in `LandscapeConfiguration.java` and still loads from `config.json`, but nothing reads it now. You may want to remove it or mark it as deprecated in a follow-up. The repository lists still use `repositoriesListLimit`, which I left alone since the task covered only contributors.

Nothing is committed.
